nom: TATCHA The Silk Cream Line-Smoothing & Firming Moisturizer

avis.texte: Bought this for my mother in law saw improvement less than a week.

avis.titre: Not as great as the purple jar
avis.texte: I used the purple jar dewy moisturizer for over 2 years and switched to this one when my last jar ran out because I'm old and thought this might be good for my lines etc. the jury is still out on that, because it's only been a few weeks, but I don't think this moisturizes the same. I miss the purple jar.

This cream does exactly what it says!!!!! Hydrates, plumps, sits beautifully under makeup and doesn't make my wrinkles look so pronounced!!!!!!! I'm 63 yrs., young and I highly recommend this product!!!!!

avis.titre: Good cream but not for this price
avis.texte: Its a decent cream but I expected other results for that price. Id compare it to other korean products that work just as well.
I've seen visable results almost immediately. However, the price is pretty steep.

avis.titre: I haven't broken out like this before!
avis.texte: Unfortunately, this is not for me. After a short time of excitedly using this cream daily, I started getting under the skin acne, which I have never had before like this. It kept getting worse. I finally put two and two together and stopped using this product and the under skin acne stopped. I am 47 years old and have not had skin like this even when I was a teen. I try a lot if different products and do not have sensitive skin… this is a first. Could just be me though.

So, I had wanted to try this for a while and finally gave it a shot. My skin broke out a little, which other moisturizers had not done before. Lines do seem a little less noticeable but for the price, just not something I would buy again

Read the ingredient list rvery single product has sugar as "Saccharomyces/Rice Ferment and it's number one on the lust or number two. No thank you im not paying so much for a product that has sufar in it Shame

I've got mature skin and it loves this stuff. This cream is not greasy or tacky. It sinks in and leaves a soft finish. My only sadness is that it is not vegan. Part of why it works so well is the silk protein which comes from silk worms. :(

I have normal skin, and it's hard to find a moisturizer that isn't too greasy and actually absorbs into my skin. This is pricey, granted, but worth every penny. It smells really fresh, not heavily perfumed. It's not a gel cream, but it's not a thick balm either. My skin feels soft and hydrated, but it doesn't make me break out. Literally perfect in every way.
